input.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE rideable_type WHEN 'electric_bike' THEN <unlock> + <ebike per-minute> * duration_min ELSE <unlock> + <classic per-minute> * duration_min END) AS pay_per_use_total FROM trips
SELECT SUM(CASE rideable_type WHEN 'electric_bike' THEN 1.00 + 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 1.00 + 0.19 * duration_min END) AS pay_per_use_total FROM trips
SELECT SUM(CASE rideable_type WHEN 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * duration_min ELSE 0.17 * MAX(0, duration_min - 45) END) AS membership_residual FROM trips

SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', started_at) AS week, COUNT(*) AS rides, AVG(duration_min) AS avg_duration_min, SUM(CASE rideable_type WHEN 'electric_bike' THEN 1.00 + 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 1.00 + 0.19 * duration_min END) AS spend FROM trips GROUP BY week ORDER BY rides DESC LIMIT 8
